thesis: EXEL is a high-quality, cash-generative biotech (operating margin 0.41, FCF 759M vs debt 162M) in a strong uptrend (close 71.74 above SMA20/50/200, 63-day +39.8%, RS +0.45) and sits in the leading health care group (XLV 21-day +10.26%) during a risk-off tape concentrated in tech and semis. Post-earnings accumulation on Oct 30 supports continuation, but the stock is extended (RSI 70.5, 8.3% above SMA20) and was rejected at 73.69 on Nov 5, so the call is only for a dip entry in 69.60-71.30 with reward/risk of about 2.1 to 76.0. Rated Overweight rather than Buy because the news and SEC feeds were unavailable, price is above the mean analyst target of 61.57, and the regime is risk-off.
